INSERT INTO media_files(
            media_id,
            type,
            download_state,
            requires_authentication,
            display_limit_in_milliseconds,
            download_token,
            encryption_key,
            encryption_mac,
            encryption_nonce,
            is_widget_media,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
